body:
Docs-only pre-registration, sealed before any run.

v3's rho=tan(30deg) has analytic worst-case arcsin(rho)=35.264deg, not the claimed 30deg — the v3 run measured 33.763deg and G2 failed on the false claim, not a geometry defect. v4 sets rho=sin(30deg)=0.5 so the 30deg cone holds by construction (verified numerically pre-seal). Only delta vs sealed v3 is that one constant; KC/MBON machinery byte-identical; H1-H4 bars unchanged; v0+v3 sealed FAILs stand, no goalpost move. R8 kill; receipt schema fixed in-doc.

Stacked on #10 (kc-geo-implementation). Main untouched.
title: geometric-PN KC v4 pre-registration SEALED (R1): cone-math correction, one-constant delta
